defaultId.description: Overrides a built-in link (by its id).

formula.description: An expression over query names, e.g. "query1 / query2 * 100".

marker.description: A horizontal line or band on the y axis (on a distribution: a percentile, {value}).

aggregator.description: How a scalar widget reduces the series; "" = the default.

bucket.description: metrics, apm_metrics, analytics, process: the bucket in milliseconds; 0 = automatic.

filters.description: Filter expression; a list is joined with " AND ".

metricName.description: apm_metrics, analytics, process, databases: the metric.

time.description: The widget's own time range; absent = the dashboard's.

value.description: How many units; "" with a custom range.

filters.description: Narrows the map, e.g. "env:prod type:db checkout". Keys: env: (exact names, several = any of them; AND-ed with env), service: (node name), type: (app; db = databases and messaging destinations; messaging = messaging sources; external, shown only with external), subtype: (e.g. mysql, redis). Several values of a key = any of them; keys are combined; "*" is a wildcard except in env:; -key:value excludes (not env:). A bare word matches node names containing it. Matched nodes are shown with their direct callers and callees.
